findings.failure_path: Rename the opening heading: awk emits its diagnostic and exits 2, but grep receives no matching input and exits 1. The pipeline therefore returns the same status as a successful zero-hit scan. Even pipefail alone retains grep's rightmost nonzero status. An automated caller accepting grep status 1 as clean can still pass an unperformed scan. The same command is generated for all three references.
findings.smallest_fix: Check extraction success before invoking grep, or perform boundary validation and token detection in one program with distinct clean, violation and error statuses. Update the generator and add a test of the complete command's status.

findings.failure_path: A third owner with an unchanged executable helper (mode 100755) now fails retirement-retarget classification even when its only change is an exact retired-owner substitution in Markdown. The previous implementation checked modes only on changed files; the new all? check rejects the entire package and demands behavioral evidence for a valid identifier rename.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep the package path/mode equality check, but apply the regular-file mode restriction only to changed files. Add a positive fixture containing an unchanged executable helper.

challenge_focus: Delta pass over every change made after the challenged commit. Open items from the previous challenge, stated verbatim as findings to re-check, not as fixed: (1) R2 P1 impact-chain-gate.rb retirement-retarget validates only changed paths, so a reference deleted beside a valid retarget could ride the identifier-rename class. (2) R2 P2 the collapse regex lacks identifier boundaries; 'product-rd-workflow and product-rd-workflow-extra' could become 'product-rd-workflow-extra'. (3) R2 P2 a personal skill declaring the retired name with the marker file is moved by the installer. (4) R1 P2 the rules file's Shared part applies the RPC/gRPC default to Node.js. (5) R5 P2 the grep-gate awk scans nothing when the opening heading is renamed and reports zero hits. (6) R3 P2 the gate command checks each boundary heading's count but not their order. (7) R3 P2 migrate_refs.py verify skips content comparison for a dangling .md symlink. Report any P0/P1 or P2 in this delta.
